title: Completed tensor product of adic coefficient algebras
statement: Let $A,R,B$ be commutative rings, $K\subset A$ an ideal [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and $f:A\to R$, $g:A\to B$ ring homomorphisms. For $n\geq 1$ form $T_n=(R/(KR)^n)\otimes_{A/K^n}(B/(KB)^n)$, with the commutative algebra tensor multiplication extending that on the module tensor [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product]. Equivalently $T_n$ is the pushout of the canonical maps $A/K^n\to R/(KR)^n$ and $A/K^n\to B/(KB)^n$ in commutative rings. Quotient reduction induces $T_{n+1}\to T_n$. Define the completed algebra tensor product to be $\varprojlim_{n\geq1}T_n$ in commutative rings, so its elements are compatible quotient tensors and its operations are componentwise.
